persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make an 8-second widescreen animation, no sound or text. A white paper plane glides through a sunny study for five seconds, then lands on a wooden desk during the last three.
bank.Which part should change?: Only the final three seconds, when the plane lands.
bank.New ending: The same white paper plane lands on an open blank notebook on the wooden desk.
bank.What should remain unchanged?: The first five seconds must remain exactly the same as the previous output.
bank.Audio and text: No sound and no visible text; the notebook pages are blank.
bank.Animation style: Keep the style of the previous video.

messages.text: I'd like you to make an animation of a white paper plane in a sunny study. I've had this little scene in my head for a while, and I'm curious to see it brought to life. It should be eight seconds long and widescreen, with no sound or text. Have the plane glide through the study for the first five seconds. Then it should land on a wooden desk during the last three seconds.
